title: post-hoc concept disentanglement: from correlated to isolated concept representations
core_idea: Introduce a post-hoc method that adds a non-orthogonality loss to the training of concept activation vectors so that correlated concepts are represented as orthogonal directions in a model's latent space while maintaining directional correctness.
tldr: Addresses entanglement of concept activation vectors for correlated concepts by proposing a post-hoc disentanglement technique using a non-orthogonality loss to obtain orthogonal, isolated concept directions; applied to activation steering tasks and evaluated on CelebA and a synthetic FunnyBirds dataset with VGG16 and ResNet18.
